thread_title: S. purpurea ssp. venosa Pender Co, NC
breadcrumb: S. purpurea ssp. venosa Pender Co, NC

posts.body_html: Here's the start of a new thread on these venosas from Pender Co, NC. I don't know much about them so far, other than they're pretty fast and easy to grow so far, and they look pretty darn red too! Maybe these will give brunswick beauty a run for it's money! Will have more to say as time goes by. In the meantime, I'm trying my best to make divisions available ASAP, probably need at least a year before they're ready to go. Pics taken 7/8/22:
